question:
**A sentence has been given with a blank to be filled with an appropriate word. Choose the correct alternative.**

If you are the one who is planning to lose weight, remember to keep your snacking_______.
solution:
The correct answer is '**moderate**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate word for the given blank is '**moderate**'.
 
• It means 'being, having, using, etc. neither too much nor too little of something'. [मध्‍यम स्‍तर का (न बहुत अधिक न बहुत कम)]
 
 
• *Example: a **moderate** speed...*
 
 
 
• Let's look at the meaning of other words:
 
 
• **outgoing**: friendly and interested in other people and new experiences. (सबसे मित्रवत तथा उनमें और नए अनुभवों में रुचि रखने वाला, सामाजिकता प्रिय, मिलनसार)
 
• **prejudiced**: not liking or trusting somebody/something for no other reason than his/her/its race, religion or sex. [पूर्वाग्रहग्रस्‍त (किसी व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु को नापसंद या उस पर अविश्‍वास करने वाला, उसकी जाति, धर्म या लिंग के कारण)]
 
• **uncontrolled**: not controlled. (नियंत्रित नहीं) 
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 4.**

 

**Correct Sentence:__** *If you are the one who is planning to lose weight, remember to keep your snacking **moderate***.
